digest: The human papillomavirus (HPV) capsid contains 360 molecules of the L1 protein, which assembles into pentamers that form the capsid shell, and up to 72 molecules of the L2 protein.

Here, we use cryo-EM single particle analysis of HPV16 pseudovirus capsids with and without the L2 protein combined with AlphaFold3 predictions and molecular dynamics simulations to develop a structural model of L2 within the capsid.

digest: Early life stress (ELS) in the form of adverse experiences in childhood results in multiple psycho-physiological pathologies during adulthood and accelerates aging.
Such pathologies are recently observed to be alleviated upon nicotinamide treatment in a maternal separation model of ELS.
We report a nicotinamide-driven amelioration of gut dysbiosis in middle-aged rodents with a history of neonatal maternal separation.

41551a0bd8fcc746.title: Nardilysin fine-tunes the mammalian circadian clock through selective modulation of PER2 function
digest: Circadian rhythms in mammals are generated by negative feedback loops, in which CLOCK and BMAL1 bind to E-box to activate transcription of Period (Per) and Cryptochrome (Cry) and the E-box-dependent transactivation is inhibited by PER and CRY proteins.
Biochemical analyses demonstrated that NRDC selectively associates with PER2 and CRY2 and antagonizes PER2-mediated repression of CLOCK-BMAL1-dependent transcription.
